topics.label: Course introduction and lecture learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and frames cancer biology across molecular mechanisms and clinical perspectives.

topics.label: Biological foundations of cancer and in vitro modeling
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the genetic, epigenetic, and developmental origins of cancer as a failure of tissue differentiation and address the limitations of modeling these processes in cell culture.

topics.label: Tumor invasion, metastasis, and benign versus malignant pathology
topics.groupedBecause: They define the processes of invasion and metastasis and illustrate the pathological differences between encapsulated benign tumors and invasive malignancies.

topics.label: Stepwise colorectal tumor progression and benign tumor behavior
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the stepwise transition from benign adenomas to invasive adenocarcinomas and analyze the clinical behaviors and risks associated with benign tumors.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the standardized rules and exceptions for naming and classifying benign and malignant tumors based on their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Pathophysiological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: It explains how primary and metastatic tumors impair physiological functions to cause clinical complications and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence in humans and comparative oncology across species
topics.groupedBecause: They present the epidemiology of common human cancers and demonstrate that tumor development is a universal feature of multicellular organisms with differentiation programs.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: They discuss the clinical signs of cancer and evaluate the histological principles, effectiveness, and challenges of screening programs across different tumor types.

topics.label: Closing remarks and summary
topics.groupedBecause: It provides concluding administrative remarks, directs students to the learning outcomes for revision, and looks ahead to upcoming practicals.
